decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-212 MODIFY already captures the revised prize headline, explanation, emphasis, style guidance, and removal of the two unwanted slogans.
Message 212 changes landing-page presentation and mechanics copy but does not direct a corresponding change to the FAQ content.
The existing MODIFY captures flexible placement and size but omits the client's explicit requirement that the supplied cover image receive a slight crop.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
hmm, I actually liked your previous version better.
The landing page header feels somewhat cluttered now because of the oversized text, and the large image overlaps the 'view dashboard' button.

I preferred having 'Project Rebuild' at the top with the subtitles and the earlier overall layout, etc.

My intention was to adjust some wording, but it doesn't need to match character for character if that makes the page look or feel cluttered, overly repetitive, or too salesy. I also wanted bold emphasis on key selling points such as '$500 random giveaway every 100 sales' or '$5 unlimited, instant commission', rather than putting those points inside brackets.

I also want the ebook cover included somewhere on the landing page. It can be any size that works with the aesthetics.

It also appears that the cover image I sent still needs a slight crop. Can you handle that, or would you prefer that I do it?

Please replace 'win $500 every 100 sales!' with '$500 giveaway every 100 sales'.
Remove 'constant little cracks at $500' and leave only '1 affiliate selected from each 100 sales block. More referrals = more chances to win!'
You can remove 'ongoing roulette spin:' as well.

(my toddlers are making me crazy right now, but I'll be back in a little while)

value_updates.placement: any aesthetically suitable location on the landing page
value_updates.size: any size that works with the landing-page aesthetics
value_updates.crop_treatment: Apply a slight crop to the supplied cover image.
